Good morning,

I am sending a safety review reminder for the Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways. Our handling standard remains calm, quiet, and humane, and every case note should be accurate before it is shared with a traveler. When a crate is reported missing, staff should record the details carefully and route the file through the usual claims path so the record stays complete. <<FACT F118>>

Please also remember that any report involving a minor injury must be documented without delay and reviewed under the normal care process. Staff should avoid speculation, keep the language neutral, and note only verified observations from the traveler, the handler, and the station team. <<FACT F113>> Keep all communication focused on the animal's welfare, the baggage record, and the follow-up steps that protect the traveler and the pet.

If you are unsure how to frame a report, use plain language and confirm the facts before replying. This helps the Companion Animal Travel Desk support travelers consistently and reduces avoidable error in our internal recordkeeping. Continue to handle each case with patience, restraint, and respect for the animal at every stage.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
